text:
Ana: Quick brainstorm — we need 3 short punchlines + 2 clean charts for the benchmark launch. Goal: homepage hero, launch post, and webinar hook. Keep claims directional, not absolute. Thoughts?
Jordan: Love this. Short headlines (<8 words). Angle idea: 'Same quality, ~3x lower per-token cost' but soften to 'in typical gen workloads' to avoid hard claims.
Mira: Draft soundbites: 1) 'Predictable performance, predictable price' 2) 'Latency-first routing keeps UX snappy' 3) 'Pay less per token without sacrificing throughput' — all short and tradeoff-focused.
Leo: Chart recs (minimal, repeatable):
- latency CDF (show p50/p90/p99) vs baseline competitors — use shaded bands for CI.
- tokens-per-dollar heatmap by sequence length & batching settings (helps PMs understand knobs).
- cost per 1k tokens across model variants (float -> quantized). Use log scale for cost axis where appropriate.
Sam: Design notes: two-panel hero: left = p99 latency bars (compact), right = tokens/$ sparkline + small table. Caption: 'Real traces from mixed web workloads — anonymized.' Keep brand palette, high contrast for p99.
Ana: Webinar hook idea: 'How we cut unit costs without breaking latency SLAs' — 20m demo (routing, caching, quant) + 10m Q/A. CTA -> signup form that sets an "interest_tag" (cost | latency | private-deploy). Route leads accordingly.
Jordan: Routing/tracking specifics: add UTM params `?utm_campaign=bench_launch&utm_source=social`. If `utm_term=latency` tag as `sla`; if `utm_term=cost` tag as `econ`. Also flag trial accounts >500k tokens/mo for AE outreach.
Mira: Short post caption variants (for A/B):
A) 'Faster responses. Lower TCO.'
B) 'Latency matters. Cost counts.'
C) 'Serve smart: latency-aware routing & caching'
I can write 5 tweet-length variants and 3 LinkedIn blurbs after design comps.
Ana: Which for hero? I vote A. Simple and punchy.
Sam: I'll mock hero using A + the two-panel layout. Will also produce an email subject test with B. ETA: EOD tomorrow for first comps.
Leo: I'll export PNGs + CSVs for the charts. Need anonymized prod traces — @ops can you grant read-only to /benching/2026? Also will add short figure captions with sample sizes and aggregation windows.
ops: granted read-only to /benching/2026 and shared a signed link. Tracking event `bench_signup` deployed to prod; includes `interest_tag`. :white_check_mark:
Mira: Great — I'll slot the caption variants into the content doc and mark preferred hero copy.
Ana: TL;DR Next steps: Sam mock hero + email subjects, Leo chart exports + captions, Mira copy variants, Jordan finalizes UTM/routing & AE rules. Check-in Friday 10:00am PT. :rocket:
Jordan: I'll also draft the landing form rules and add the routing matrix to the growth doc.
Sam: Noted. Will add export-friendly assets (SVG + PNG).
Leo: Pushing initial CSVs to the shared bench folder in ~2h.
Mira: I'll schedule copy review slot on Thursday 3pm.
Ana: Awesome — thanks team. Small ask: keep all public-facing copy under review to avoid hard numeric claims.
Jordan: Agreed. We'll use relative language and call out test conditions in the appendix for transparency.
Ana: Closing this thread for now — will reopen after comps.
